commitResults.messageTitle: Rename main class and Add greeting

commitResults.messageBody:
Agents do not have a local checklist for Git conventions.

Inconsistent commit messages make project history harder to review.

Add a skill based on the SE-EDU Git conventions.

Require agents to use it for future commits and branch names.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
commitResults.messageBody:
Agents do not have a project-specific source for Java coding rules.

Add a local skill that records the SE-EDU rules.

Require agents to use it for every Java change and review.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move task classes into ted package
commitResults.messageBody:
Task and Ted use the default package and Ted has no API documentation.

This conflicts with the project's Java coding standard.

Move both classes into the ted package and add the required Javadoc.

Update the setup instructions to use the new source location.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for tracking ToDos, Events and Deadlines

commitResults.messageBody:
Ted.main mixes command dispatch, parsing, task storage, and output. The mark
and unmark commands also duplicate validation logic, making changes harder to
maintain.

Extract command dispatch and per-command handlers. Centralise task insertion
and capacity checks, and define command names as constants. Preserve the
existing command syntax and output.

Update the UI test transcript with the verified behaviour.

README contains only starter-template setup instructions, so users cannot
see Ted's purpose, commands, or verification resources.

Replace the template text with a Ted overview, feature list, Java 25 setup
steps, command reference, example session, documentation links, and the
required AI-use acknowledgement. Organise the content around the actual CLI
workflow so new users can run and understand Ted without consulting source
code.

Route command validation failures through TedException.

Keep the task list unchanged when a command is rejected.

Place task classes in ted.task and TedException in ted.exception.
Update imports while keeping src/main/java as the source root.
